title: Playboy Magazine October 1985 Jerry Hall Annie Leibovitz John DeLorean Collector
conditionDescription: Cover clean with light edge and handling wear. Centerfold not separately verified.
descriptionText:
Vintage Playboy Magazine, October 1985 issue. Cover price $3.50. Collector's Edition with the new cover look.

Features:
- Supermodel Jerry Hall, photos by Annie Leibovitz
- John DeLorean Finally Gets Cross-Examined
- Plus Tom McGuane, Dan Jenkins, Robert Stone, Buck Henry, Rosanna Arquette, Bob Greene

Lace-veil cover. The back cover carries the 1985 Lucky Strike "Light my Lucky" ad.

Condition: pre-owned with normal signs of age and storage. Cover clean with light edge and handling wear. The centerfold has not been separately verified - please ask before buying if that matters to you. Please review the photos - they are of the actual copy you will receive.
